:::{#def-gradient-flow}
#### Gradient flow

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ have first [partial derivatives](vector-calculus.qmd#def-partial-derivative).
A **gradient flow** of $f$ is a [differentiable](calculus.qmd#def-differentiable) curve $\vx : [0, \infty) \to \reals^p$ that satisfies

$$
\dif{\vx(t)}{t} = -\deriv{\vx} f(\vx(t)).
$$

:::
